name: Zymbly
summary: Voice-first AI copilot for aircraft technicians: describe a fault, get troubleshooting help and parts lookup, then dictate the fix to draft the maintenance record.
paragraphs: Voice-first AI copilot for aircraft technicians: describe a fault, get troubleshooting help and parts lookup, then dictate the fix to draft the maintenance record.
whyItMatters: Targets the paperwork and lookup time around each job, a big share of a technician's shift.
